scope.review_mode: read-only source and test inspection; no build or workload

findings: The receipt is private, operation-local, tied to a fresh writer/output vector, and accepted only after successful reuse-plan validation and emission.
The source-bound overlay, rewrite, no-source, plan-decline, and from-scratch routes retain full Package::capture and allocation reuse.

Metadata-only projection covers root, storages, and streams by exact path and kind, retains traversal and Budget order, checks one-to-one coverage and staged stream lengths, and installs final SID/link/class/time/start/size/MiniFAT metadata before discovery.
Final OleFile open and protection admission remain mandatory; payload omission is justified only by the validated immutable ReusePlan model and same fresh emission.

The existing tests cover CFB layout faults, MiniFAT transitions, directory metadata, limits, and public atomicity, but do not by themselves prove the new handoff; the design correctly requires an independent full-capture differential oracle.
implementation_gates: Compare candidate and full-capture packages including root Metadata (SID 0, kind, links, CLSID, state, FILETIMEs, start, size, MiniFAT), storage/stream order, and every stream Arc identity on eligible reuse.

Prove receipt absence and unchanged full capture for copy-through, changed-but-net-equal batches, add/remove/rename/move/nested topology, rewrite, no source, source-adoption decline, and all plan fallbacks.
Cover 512/4096 sector files and zero, mini, regular, mixed, partial, and mini-to-regular/regular-to-mini transitions, including root and MiniFAT growth or shrink.
Exercise malformed/decode/limit/protection and projection mismatch paths, temporary-index allocation fallback, and public failure atomicity while preserving existing error ordering.
